title: Sitemap URL Extractor
description: Get every page URL a website lists in its XML sitemaps, with last-modified date, change frequency, priority and image count. Finds sitemaps via robots.txt, follows sitemap indexes, reads .xml.gz and text sitemaps.

websites.title: Websites or sitemap URLs
websites.description: A domain (sitemaps are found through robots.txt and common locations) or a direct sitemap URL. Up to 500 per run.

maxUrlsPerSite.title: Maximum URLs per site
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Stop collecting a site after this many URLs.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip sitemaps the site asks bots not to fetch. Recommended.

url.title: URL found
url.description: One page URL returned from a sitemap. Sites with no sitemap are free.

store.seoTitle: Sitemap URL Extractor - All Pages of Any Website
store.seoDescription: Extract every URL from a site's XML sitemaps with lastmod, priority and change frequency. Auto-discovers sitemaps, follows indexes, reads .gz.
